name: fresh-microservices
description: 生鲜电商微服务系统（练手项目）：Gateway / Auth / Catalog / Inventory / Order

scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,catalog,inventory,order -c blue,green,cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @fresh/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @fresh/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @fresh/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @fresh/inventory-service" "npm run dev -w @fresh/order-service"
